title: When the Hollow Burns Anew
author: Mara Pemberton
blurb: Wren Eriksen, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
